Overview

Albury is a city in New South Wales with a population of 56,504. NSW’s border city on the Murray River with a vibrant arts scene, wineries, and outdoor adventures. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
